name: Noita
description: Play Noita together. Noita Entangled Worlds shares one world between players: their positions, health, perks, wands, enemies and even the pixels of the cave.

setup.title: Noita
setup.detail: Install Noita from your Steam library.
Download the mod above: Cairn puts it in Noita's folder.

hostSteps: Download the mod above. Cairn puts it in Noita's folder and keeps it up to date.
Press Play. Noita Entangled Worlds' own window opens.
In that window choose Host, then Start: it starts Noita for you.
Share the lobby code it shows with your friends, or invite them on Steam.
joinSteps: Download the mod above, the same version as the host's, then press Play.
In Entangled Worlds' window choose Join and enter the host's lobby code.
It starts Noita for you and you arrive in the host's world.

items.name: Host and join
items.detail: Join by Steam lobby code or by address. Both players need the same version of the mod.

items.name: Same world
items.detail: One world for everyone: the same cave, pixel by pixel, enemies and items.

items.name: Kept up to date
items.detail: Cairn installs the mod in Noita's folder and updates it when a new version is released.

items.name: Everything they carry
items.detail: Positions, health, perks, wands and inventories are shared.

items.name: Wands and items
items.detail: A wand or a potion one player throws can be picked up by another.
